text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the morning, when I arrived at the 
Trainer's Room, Mejiro Dober was already 
there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
! ...I-It's totally normal, alright? Doing 
this much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Looks like the new aroma I bought 
really worked... I slept like a baby!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Aren't you the one running slow? ...Are 
you sleeping properly?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
How about you, Trainer? Are you getting 
enough sleep?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...You should get some proper sleep on 
your days off. Try using some aromatherapy 
or something."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I see... But I'm still worried. You tend 
to push yourself too hard, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
! I-I'm just giving you a warning! It'd be 
a pain if something happened to you! 
...Got that!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's my line. If it'll help, I can 
recommend some nice aromas for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I should follow Mejiro Dober's example and 
get some quality rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I should follow Mejiro Dober's example and 
get some quality rest.
